name: DevPilot AI Retrieval v3 Independent Validation

methodology.purpose: Independent generalization evaluation for Retrieval v3
rules: Repositories must not have been used for Retrieval v3 tuning.
Questions and expected files must be frozen before running Retrieval v3.
No retrieval parameter may be changed after inspecting validation results.
The validation run is one-shot for the frozen Retrieval v3 configuration.
Any later tuning converts this dataset into development data.
